title: Molluscum Contagiosum Virus Real-Time PCR
author: Judy A Northill
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.kmtcu6n
materials: The assay has been optimised and validated for the Rotor-Gene 6000 and Rotor-Gene Q thermocyclers. PCR *Florescence acquisition step

steps.title: Prepare PCR Reaction Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare the PCR reaction mix using Bioline product BIO-84005 and SensiFAST™ Probe Lo-ROX Kit (Catalog #BIO-84002). Prepare enough volume for the required number of reactions plus a 'dead volume' of typically 2 extra reactions, adjusting for robotic dispensers if necessary.

steps.title: Dispense Reaction Mix
steps.instruction: Dispense 15µL of the prepared reaction mix into each reaction well.

steps.title: Add Template DNA
steps.instruction: Add 5µL of template (extracted DNA, controls, or NTC nuclease-free water) to each well to reach a total reaction volume of 20µL.

steps.title: Run Real-Time PCR
steps.instruction: Perform the assay using either a Rotor-Gene 6000 / Rotor-Gene Q 5-plex with 100-place rotor discs or an ABI 7500 using 96-well plates.

steps.title: Analyze Results
steps.instruction: Evaluate the real-time fluorogenic PCR results based on the following criteria for a satisfactory positive result:

substeps.instruction: Verify the presence of a sigmoidal curve (horizontal start, upward curve, exponential rise, and horizontal plateau phase).
Confirm fluorescence intensity is suitable compared to a positive control.
Ensure the fluorescent curve clearly exceeds a defined threshold (CT) value within the log-linear phase.
Confirm that NTCs do not produce a curve.
Classify any result not exceeding the threshold within 40 cycles as a negative result.
